scope_note: The counselling and dispensing pair, repaired after the V7 round and re-sealed at content version 2. The counselling section now teaches that M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21A requires no counselling of a person who declines the offer, while keeping that disclaimer distinct from 247 CMR 9.18(4), which states its trigger without equivalent words; it also carries the statutory content list, the third-party payer sentence and the inpatient reservation in the statute's own terms. The dispensing section stops treating 247 CMR 9.04(8) as settling who may take a new prescription by telephone and teaches 247 CMR 8.04(4)(c) alongside it. Four additive rules carry the added law. Scope gate: SG-MA-COUNSELING has no actionable signal; SG-MA-DISPENSING-LABEL-AND-RECORD's six were declined as compounded-preparation labelling and prescription-format material the section's own boundary paragraph places outside its scope.
